children.value: Frequently Asked Questions
How many nic shots for 50ml?

One 10ml 18mg nic shot is the standard dose for a 50ml shortfill: it fills the empty 10ml in the 60ml bottle and gives 60ml at 3mg. For 6mg you need two shots, which only fit if you pour 10ml of shortfill out first, leaving 40ml plus 20ml of shots.
Is Pachamama vape juice good?

Pacha Mama is one of the better-reviewed fruit shortfill ranges in the UK. A UK vape review site scored the original shortfill line 8.7 out of 10 overall, with Fuji Apple Strawberry Nectarine at 9.5 and Mango Pitaya Pineapple at 9, praising the layered three-fruit recipes and the vapour from the 70/30 mix.
What is a Pachamama vape?

Pacha Mama, also written Pachamama, is the exotic fruit e-liquid range from Charlie's Chalk Dust, a California e-liquid company. In the UK it is sold as a 0mg 50ml shortfill for sub-ohm kits, a 100ml shortfill, and a 10ml nic salt at 10mg or 20mg for pod kits. There is no Pacha Mama device.
How much does a Pachamama vape cost?

Pacha Mama 50ml E-Liquid costs £6.99 with no nic shots, £7.99 with two 18mg nic shots and £8.99 with five 18mg nic shots at Vape Online Store as of October 2026. The 100ml shortfill starts at £7.99 and the 10ml nic salt is £3.99, so the 50ml works out at roughly 14p per ml.
Can you use shortfill without nicotine?
Yes. Pacha Mama 50ml E-Liquid is 0mg as sold, so you can vape it straight from the bottle with no shot added. Choose No Nic Shots, shake and fill; the flavour and 70/30 ratio are the same either way.
How do I add nic shots to a shortfill bottle?
Unscrew the cap, lift out the plastic nozzle, empty one 10ml 18mg shot into the 60ml bottle, refit the nozzle and cap, then shake hard for 30 seconds and let it stand an hour or two before filling.
How do I open a shortfill bottle?

Press down on the childproof cap and twist anticlockwise. Underneath is a plastic nozzle pressed into the neck; hook a thumbnail or coin edge under its rim and lift it out to add a shot, then push it back in.
Which shortfill VG/PG ratio is best for sub-ohm?

70/30 VG/PG, which is what Pacha Mama 50ml E-Liquid uses. The high VG gives dense, smooth clouds on a 0.15 to 0.6 ohm coil, while the 30 per cent PG keeps enough flavour and wicking to avoid dry hits.
Can I use Pacha Mama 50ml E-Liquid in a pod kit?

Only in a direct-lung pod with a coil of 0.6 ohm or lower. Mouth-to-lung pods with 1.0 ohm or higher coils cannot wick 70VG fast enough and will burn; for those, use the Pacha Mama 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid instead.
What does the 5 x 18mg Nic Shots option mean?
It adds five 10ml 18mg nic shots to your order for £2 more than the plain bottle. Five shots do not go into one bottle; they are a stock for your next bottles, five at 3mg or two at 6mg.
